name: Boeing 737-300

reference.engine: CFM56-3B1/-3B2 (flat-bottom 'hamster pouch' nacelle, oval inlet, no chevrons)
reference.notes: Original Classic 737-300 as drawn in Boeing D6-58325-6 sec 2.2.3. CFM56-3 nacelle is flattened underneath for ground clearance (side-view height ~1.8 m vs plan width ~2.2 m, both measured off the Boeing three-view; engine ground clearance 0.46-0.53 m per sec 2.3.2). Aviation Partners blended-winglet retrofits exist for the 737-300/-500 but are rare on the type, so the plain tip is the reference. Wing LE is one straight ~30 deg line with no Yehudi LE break (unlike NG/MAX). Tailcone is the shortest/shallowest of the three. Heights in dims are from ground-clearance table (vertical tail 11.07-11.15 m). Fin height above crown 5.9 m = tail clearance minus top-of-fuselage clearance (sec 2.3.2). v3: fin root now excludes the dorsal fillet (see vtail.dorsalLength).

name: Boeing 737-800

reference.notes: Reference = 737-800W as drawn in D6-58325-7 sec 2.2.6; the blended winglet is the common NG configuration, so span is 35.79 m, not the winglet-less span. Split scimitar is an Aviation Partners retrofit (e.g. Ryanair) and is NOT used; contrast photo is in refs/B738. Nacelle: 2.13 m plan width, ~1.8 m height (flat-bottom, ground clearance 0.48-0.64 m per sec 2.3.2); fan face at x=13.36 m (documented). Wing has a Yehudi LE break (inboard LE ~37 deg out to y~5.5, outboard ~27 deg) and TE kink at y=5.5. Fin height above crown 7.0 m = vertical tail minus top-of-fuselage clearance (12.62-5.56 OEW, 12.37-5.41 MTW), documented; the three-view scale reads ~7.7 so treat +/-0.4. Tailcone: fuselage ends at 38.02 m (doc) vs 39.47 overall (to horizontal stabiliser tip). v3: the fin root (rootLEx 28.9, rootChord 8.2) used to include the dorsal fillet; rootLEx/rootChord now describe the fin proper and the fillet is vtail.dorsalLength/dorsalHeight. Fin is the same as B38M.

name: Boeing 737 MAX 8

reference.engine: CFM LEAP-1B (round nacelle ~2.4 m, serrated chevron nozzle)
reference.wingtip: Advanced Technology (dual-feather) winglet: upper blade + lower blade
reference.notes: Reference = 737-8 in D6-38A004 sec 2.2.2. NOT split scimitar: the MAX AT winglet has an upper blade (~2.1 m above the wing tip, leaning ~32 deg outward) and a short lower blade (~0.8 m below, ~60 deg from vertical); total blade-to-blade height 2.92 m (doc, 9 ft 7 in) matches the sum. Blade clearances: lower 2.79-3.15 m, upper 5.72-6.07 m (sec 2.3.2). Nacelle is bigger and round (front view ~2.4 m, vs the NG's flattened ~2.13 x 1.8) with chevrons on the nozzle; fan face is documented at x=13.00 m vs NG 13.36 m, so by the planning drawing it is only ~0.4 m further forward (the 'higher' mounting could not be confirmed from the drawing). Tailcone: fuselage length 39.12 m (doc) vs NG 38.02 m, i.e. the MAX tailcone is ~1.1 m longer and ends higher; overall length per this Boeing drawing is 39.47 m (secondary sources and aircraft-top20.json say 39.52). Fin shown identical to NG within measurement error. v3: rootChord 8.6 vs B738 8.2 was one fin measured from the fillet start with different drawing scale error; both now share fin LE 31.65, TE 37.05 (chord 5.4) plus a 2.85 x 1.5 m fillet.
